ops.loadingHours: The reserved time includes the time needed for setup and removal. For exhibition use, load-in and load-out outside the reserved hours incur a separate charge (Price list PDF, October 2024). For banquets, meetings and similar events, if you ask a vendor other than the hotel's designated ones to handle decorations, signage, sound, lighting and the like directly, notify the hotel in advance and obtain approval. Load-in and load-out of the vendor's equipment and materials, and the size, mounting method and location of signs, are arranged with the hotel's staff under certain rules.
ops.parking: Mitsui Repark Hotel Le Port Kojimachi parking lot (40 spaces). Height limit 2.3 m. Open 24 hours, 440 yen per 20 minutes (tax included). Daily maximum is 2,800 yen for 8:00-20:00 and 500 yen for 20:00-8:00 (tax included). Meeting and banquet guests get up to 3 hours free. For large vehicles that do not fit in the lot, separate parking space is provided (listed as 5,300 yen per night, reservation required).
ops.waitingRooms: There are waiting rooms on the 2F and 3F. The fee is 10,648 yen for the basic 2 hours and 3,993 yen for each additional hour (tax and service charge included, Price list PDF, October 2024). Sango and Shinju on the 4F are described as rooms that can also be used as waiting rooms for guests of honor and the like.
ops.catering: Meeting boxed lunches are available. Kojimachi bento: Sazanka 2,783 yen, Botan 3,388 yen, Kikyo 3,993 yen, Renge 4,840 yen (tax and service charge included, after the revision of October 1, 2026). Sushi bento are not accepted from July to September. Banquet plans include kaiseki, French cuisine and party plans. Breakfast meetings are for 6 to 270 people, with Japanese breakfast bento available.
ops.restaurants: The hotel has the Japanese-Western restaurant Piazza, the sushi restaurant Hirakawa and the sake bar Komichi (all on B1F), and Lounge Cascade (1F). For dining and parties in the banquet rooms, alumni and classmate reunion plans and party plans are offered.
